mentions.name: Ghost-race running watch app
mentions.description: A watch app for runners that lets them compete against their own previous runs using a ghost-racing mechanic inspired by 1990s rally games.
mentions.source_excerpt: A watch app for runners that focuses on competing against previous runs, inspired by the rally games of the 90s where you could race your "ghosts"
